snippet.title: Fall Guys - Crown Jam Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
LESS FALLIN’. MORE BALLIN’
The Beans are bouncing into Fortnite with Crown Jam 👑 

A new limited-time 3v3 arcade sport from the world of Fall Guys ARRIVES JAN 23, running through Feb 9 (ends 9:30 AM ET).

Learn more: https://www.fallguys.com/en-US/news/the-beans-slam-dunk-in-fortnite-for-a-limited-time-crown-jam

Download Fall Guys now: www.fallguys.com
